summary: Join Policy Analysis for Gender Equality Training to develop essential skills for crafting effective policies that advance gender equality and social justice.
lede: Gender-responsive policy analysis helps policy professionals assess how legislation, programs, and budgets affect different demographic groups. For analysts and practitioners designing or evaluating policies, the course develops skills in intersectional data analysis, gender impact assessments, gender-responsive budgeting, and stakeholder consultation to identify risks and shape inclusive interventions.
audienceIntro: This advanced program is structured for professionals who are directly responsible for designing, evaluating, or funding public and organizational policies. It provides the technical depth required to operationalize gender mainstreaming across complex institutional environments.
audience: Gender Equality and Social Inclusion (GESI) Advisors
modules: Strategic Policy Briefs and Action Planning
prerequisites: Participants should have foundational experience in policy design, public administration, social inclusion programs, or monitoring and evaluation. Familiarity with basic data analysis and organizational budgeting processes is recommended. No advanced statistical software coding is required.
